As a secondary offshoot of the same 'word becomes identified' event it also fires, more weakly, on whole-token low-frequency content verbs of narrative clauses ('heard', 'found', 'listened', 'met', 'sang', 'seen'), and on '$' introducing a number; it is near zero on frequent nouns, function words and ordinary expository prose.
